_description: Scrapes followers of known Indian creator accounts. Run 3x/week (Mon/Wed/Fri) at 6am IST. These followers are pre-qualified because they follow course creators — they likely run their own audiences. Filter in n8n: keep only those with 20K–300K followers on their own profiles.
_runSchedule: 3x per week — Monday, Wednesday, Friday at 6am IST
_n8nWebhook: Set Apify actor webhook to POST to your n8n 'Apify → Airtable' flow URL
_filterNote: n8n post-processing: for each follower returned, only push to Airtable if their own followerCount is between 20000 and 300000
_usernameRotationNote: Run a separate actor task per account. Rotate accounts across the 3 weekly runs to avoid hammering the same account daily. Suggested rotation: Mon=akshatsrivastava_+ankurwarikoo, Wed=rajshamani+anushkarathod_, Fri=sharanhegde+nikhilkamathofficial+warikoo
